imported_statement: Theorem3(1)-(2), printed p408, PDF page7: a complex plane Keller pair with one component of prime degree or degree4 is a polynomial automorphism. Degree1 is elementary; hence every plane Keller pair whose component degrees are both<=4 is invertible.
title: A generalization of Magnus' theorem
used_only_for: The f=1 branch, where quotient(g,h) has ordinary degrees<=4. The source map is injective for a!=0 by this theorem; its a0 restriction is triangular, so no collisions.
